requirement: App Statistic handles session redirects and non-JSON responses without parsing login HTML

oracle.invariant: A valid JSON response retains credentials and is read without alteration. A sign-in redirect including browser opaqueredirect requests sign-in and is never parsed as JSON. Forbidden, HTTP failure, HTML and invalid JSON produce distinct readable errors. Detail uses the same response protection and cancellation is preserved.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: statistics reads keep credentials, request JSON and stop login redirects before parsing
expired session responses request sign-in without parsing HTML, including browser opaque redirects
forbidden, failed, HTML and invalid JSON statistics responses have distinct readable errors
detail reads share the same protection and preserve aborted request cancellation
